Raw refusals: 'ERROR: Cannot read parameter 1 [b_delay.brk]: brkpnt_files not permitted.' (params 1-8 positional in banner order; 9 = -p prescale). seed (-s) not brk-probed (semantically meaningless); false.

HEADLINE DIVERGENCE: -s seed is a NO-OP and the negative-lfofreq 'random oscillation' path is fully deterministic in this build. Seeds 1/3/5/9/77/99/200 and unseeded runs 1.1 s apart all produce identical decoded samples; the random path IS active (pos vs neg lfofreq differ, lfophase changes the neg-freq output). Mechanism from source: newsfsys/osbind.c defines drand48() as rand()/RAND_MAX (nm shows 'T drand48' in the modify binary), overriding libc, while modify/delay.c seeds glibc srand48(seed) on non-Windows - the wrong generator. On _WIN32 the code path calls srand(seed), which does feed the shim, so seed presumably works there. Entry: stochastic false, version_sensitive true, seed exposed with the no-op documented.
DIVERGENCE: cgromody.htm documents tail range '-1.0 to 1.0'; binary enforces 'out of range (0.000000 to 30.000000)' (refuses -0.5, accepts 2.0).

Source-confirmed enum (envlcon.h ENVTYPE_LIN/EXP/STEEP/DBL); 'dovetail 1 ... 3 3' is byte-identical to 'dovetail 2' with the same fades, so submode 2 is a special case of submode 1.
